settings.content: The menu band (every page except the homepage) and the homepage nav use these three links. For each URL field, click it and SELECT the page from the dropdown (Pages → Shop / Lookbook / Info). Do not type the URL by hand — the picker always uses the correct address even if the page handle differs.

settings.content: Locks the Shop page until the drop time, with an early-access code page (/pages/early-access). NOTE: this is a soft, client-side gate for the test phase — the code lives in the page source and is bypassable by technical users. For a hard lock use scheduled publishing or an app (e.g. Locksmith).
